verdict.rationale: Alma is a technology-enabled immigration law firm with a client portal, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask. The evidence never describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from a user's data. The risk-flagging system, the 'case intelligence' from prior filings, and the visa recommendations on the homepage are never described as AI-generated or as derived from the user's own data inside the product. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
